subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers keep this umbrella open while splitting the remaining session-routing behaviors, or close it only after focused follow-ups cover all unresolved parts?
rationale: Current main still shows multiple unresolved symptoms, but the issue spans core TUI/Gateway behavior, an external WeChat plugin boundary, and product-level background-event/activity semantics that should not be collapsed into one automated fix.

options.title: Split and keep routed
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella for now, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93255 for their narrower parts, and create focused follow-ups for TUI default session, WeChat proof, and event-flood isolation.

options.title: Use as umbrella only
options.body: Leave this issue open as the sole tracking item and block automation until maintainers reproduce the WeChat and flooding behavior live.

options.title: Close after follow-ups exist
options.body: Close this issue only once every unresolved behavior is covered by a focused open issue or merged fix with evidence preserved there.

recommendation.title: Split and keep routed
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella for now, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93255 for their narrower parts, and create focused follow-ups for TUI default session, WeChat proof, and event-flood isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest cross-surface owner signal available from current blame and prior review evidence for TUI, session list, and product-direction decisions.
